name: Lu Weijun
source: Coming from a well-off family, June is studying Information science abroad. She is intelligent, proud and patriotic. Her heart aches whenever she thinks how her hometown steadily deteriorates. Apart from her studies, she is also working on her album. It's a shame that a talented and pretty girl like her is not dating anyone.
